an3.111:1.5: Any deed that emerges from hate—born, sourced, and originated from hate—is unskillful, blameworthy, results in suffering, and leads to the creation of more deeds, not their cessation.
an3.111:1.6: Any deed that emerges from delusion—born, sourced, and originated from delusion—is unskillful, blameworthy, results in suffering, and leads to the creation of more deeds, not their cessation.
an3.111:2.5: Any deed that emerges from love—born, sourced, and originated from love—is skillful, blameless, results in happiness, and leads to the cessation of more deeds, not their creation.
an3.111:2.6: Any deed that emerges from understanding—born, sourced, and originated from understanding—is skillful, blameless, results in happiness, and leads to the cessation of more deeds, not their creation.
